title: Open Milestones and the Restart Re-Pricing — Professional Services Projects
content:
For the restart re-pricing of a fixed-fee Professional Services Projects engagement, the milestones still open on the class schedule add points.

## Clause

Where the class schedule has milestones, they number one plus the shares left after the class deposit percentage and the class holdback percentage and the last milestone's share, divided by the largest milestone share, and a class schedule with no milestones has none, so that no milestone remains open and no points are added. 1.0 point is added to the restart re-pricing when three or more milestones are not yet recorded complete, 0.5 point when exactly two are not, and none otherwise.

## Milestones on each class schedule

| Engagement class | Count worked from the schedule | Milestones |
|---|---|---|
| Assessment Engagement | no milestones on the schedule | 0 |
| Quick Start Project | no milestones on the schedule | 0 |
| Standard Project | 100 less 30, 10 and 30 leaves 30; divided by 30 gives 1; plus one | 2 |
| Advanced Project | 100 less 25, 10 and 15 leaves 50; divided by 25 gives 2; plus one | 3 |
| Major Project | 100 less 20, 10 and 10 leaves 60; divided by 20 gives 3; plus one | 4 |
| Strategic Program | 100 less 15, 10 and 15 leaves 60; divided by 15 gives 4; plus one | 5 |

| Milestones not yet recorded complete | Points added |
|---|---|
| three or more | 1.0 |
| exactly two | 0.5 |
| one or none | none |

Hypothetical illustration: a Major Project with one milestone recorded complete has three not yet recorded complete and carries 1.0 point; with two recorded complete it carries 0.5 point.
